blind.sample_role: Participants in the proactive-coping repeated-measures analysis: 64 course participants and 73 control patients.
blind.exclusions: Restricted to patients stating a goal at both T1 and T2; the 180 questionnaire completers (78 intervention, 102 control) are not the target analytic sample. Recruitment allocated 119 intervention and 108 control; intervention dropouts were 30 before and 11 during the course, and control dropouts were four due to ill-health and two due to form-completion difficulties.
